hardware: One NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10, 128 GB unified memory
runtime: vLLM 0.28.1rc1.dev324+ga56654d6d with vllm-exl3 (native pack integration on main, unreleased 0.4.0)

sweep.mean_definition: Arithmetic mean of all listed per-run decode rates. Calculated from the published, rounded run values. Not pooled throughput, not a paired speedup, and not a confidence interval.

long_prompt.scope: Separate long-prompt probe, not a complete k=0..3 sweep at 256K, and not a full 262144-token prefill. Retain the source rounded label about 43 tok/s rather than inventing extra precision.

caveats: Two measurement dates are present. The 2026-09-07 sweep ran on the build that predated the fat-expert and dense-routing fixes; the 2026-09-13 envelope ran on vllm-exl3 0.4.2 and supersedes it for speed.
MTP k is the number of speculative draft tokens, not quantization bit width.
KV pool capacity is shared serving capacity, not validated per-request input length.

Bit-exact output equivalence is not established and cannot be tested by text diff on this engine: at temperature 0 with a fixed seed the same server returned four distinct outputs from five identical requests on an open-ended prompt.
Decode figures exclude time to first token.
Bit-exact full-output equivalence is not established. These are timing/probe results, not a quality evaluation.
No raw per-request JSON logs were present in the inspected recipe tree; listed README values are preserved.

envelope.method: Decode excludes TTFT. Median of four samples at short context, two at long. Every sample uses a unique prompt prefix so prefix caching cannot fake a cold prefill.

sweep.label: MTP k=4
sweep.note: engine wedges after torch.compile and never allocates KV

ssm_bf16.verdict: KV pool up about 8 percent. Any decode gain sits inside the sample spread and is not established.

cliff.finding: Draft acceptance collapses to exactly 0.000 at every position between 163,428 and 178,287 tokens. Past the cliff the draft head keeps drafting and the target rejects all of it, so speculation costs about 21 percent against no draft. A chunk carrying 1.00 tokens means nothing was accepted.
cliff.recommendation: MTP k=3 below about 163k tokens. SPEC_CONFIG=none above it.
